name: TOTP Sign-In Flow Integration Proof
summary: Registers real-path integration proof for accepted and rejected TOTP sign-in through AuthenticationFlowService, the typed TOTP handler, AppUserMfaManager and the real LagoVista SignInManager.
notes: The proof harness does not mock AppUserMfaManager or the LagoVista SignInManager; persistence, secure storage, redirect resolution and the ASP.NET Identity SignInManager adapter are infrastructure/framework seams.

The successful web-session path currently also emits PasswordAuthenticationSucceeded from the shared CompleteSignInToAppAsync implementation. That legacy event is recorded explicitly rather than hidden by the proof.
The mobile token adapter reuses the same TOTP proof and then internally exchanges an existing single-use token through the established access/refresh-token pipeline.
